retrievalProfile.description: A warm, high-contrast portrait of a musician in a rustic barn setting featuring golden-hour side lighting and elegant, stacked serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a mustard-yellow shirt and dark trousers sits on a hay bale inside a weathered wooden barn, playing an acoustic guitar. The scene is illuminated by strong, warm directional light from the right, creating deep shadows on the left. Elegant, white, high-contrast serif text is stacked in the upper-left quadrant, partially overlapping the dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm yellow shirt against dark weathered wood
Directional light highlighting the guitar and the subject's face
Stacked white typography balanced against the subject's seated form
Textural contrast between dry hay, rough wood, and smooth guitar finish
coreInvariants: Acoustic guitar as a central prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated right-of-center, occupying approximately two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar and the subject's hands form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright typography in the top left, moves down the subject's arm to the guitar, and follows the light across his face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper left and far left provide a canvas for the display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks of the barn interior and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mustard yellow of the shirt and golden tones of the hay.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit subject and the dark background; warm, earthy saturation.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly tracked letters with occasional overlaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales for name and title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule-like spacing between name and title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the original.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a mustard yellow long-sleeve shirt and black pants, sitting on a hay bale inside a dark wooden barn, playing an acoustic guitar. Use strong golden-hour side lighting from the right to create deep shadows on the left side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name and title in the top left corner using a high-contrast white serif font, stacked vertically with tight leading and tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and warm?
Is the text white and high-contrast serif?
Is the background dark weathered wood?
Is the subject seated on hay?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any brand logos on the guitar headstock
Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the guitar looks like a realistic acoustic model.
Verify the lighting direction is consistent across the subject and hay.
Confirm the typography uses sharp, elegant serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Directional Golden Light + Stacked High-Contrast Serif Typography
